---
title: "Before the session"
---
Before the session, read the background page and check that the deck of the session loads on the machine that you will bring. There is nothing to install and nothing to register for.

## 1. Background {#the-case-study}

[Read the background](../../background.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

The background page presents the claim on which the session works, and how the five analysts of the robustness study of SCORE (Multi100; Aczel et al. 2026) came to different conclusions about it.

## 2. The deck

[Open the deck at Task 1](../../live/short.html#/hands-on-1-get-yourself-running){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 1](../../lab.qmd#task-1-setup){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

The deck of the session runs R inside your browser, with the data already in place. Open it once on the machine and in the browser that you will use (a recent version of Chrome, Edge or Firefox), wait until the setup cell shows a "Run Code" button, and run it. If the deck does not load, try another browser, and tell the facilitator before the session. The browser lab holds the same tasks and is the fallback.

## 3. On the day

Bring a laptop and its charger.
